description: Fetches the saved budget note for a WBS code. The data field is null when no note exists for the WBS code.

note.description: The note that was saved for a budget or a forecast row

user.description: Display name of the user who last created or updated the note. Null when no author history is available.

updated_at.description: Human-readable, locale- and timezone-formatted timestamp of when the note was last updated. Display only; not ISO 8601.
